en: Black‑and‑white view of a large cobblestoned town square bordered by substantial historic buildings. Dominating the scene is a long, multi‑storey structure with steep tiled roofs, dormer windows, and a prominent clock‑tower with a spire to the left, plus another tall church‑like tower with a spire to the right. At street level are arched entrances with staircases, and several shop signs on the ground floor. A few pedestrians in early‑20th‑century clothing walk across the otherwise empty square; a handcart stands on the right edge of the image. The composition and wide foreground suggest it was intended as a postcard view of the main square and town hall of a central‑European town.
